notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
[h1]BIG UPDATE[/h1]
I'm back with a BIG update, and this time i'm taking it literally! The short boost "Super Size" doubles you in size, and makes you do twice the damage! I'm sure a lot of you will also enjoy the newly added [b]- Aim Assist -[/b] feature for controllers. You can adjust the Aim Assist strength, or turn it off, in the options menu.

Come check out the new features and let me know what else you would like to see implemented!

[h2]New short boost: Super Size[/h2]
[*] [b]Added:[/b] Short Boost "Super Size". Double the size, twice the damage!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45165535/8eb63fc96ff383cfcae374f1543dcbdc35a842ac.gif[/img]

[h2]New: Aim Assist[/h2]
[*] [b]Added:[/b] Aim assist for controllers. You can adjust the strength, or turn it off, in the options menu. When the target is within range, the aim assist will help aim towards the target.

[h2]New: Hitstop effect[/h2]
[*] [b]Added:[/b] Hitstop effect for the following attacks:
[list]
[*] No weapon: Normal attack (80ms)
[*] Melee weapons: Knife (90ms) and Laser Sword (110ms)
[*] Normal weapons: Sniper and Shotgun (both 50ms) and Rocket explosion (150ms)
[*] Ultra weapons: Singularis and Pulsorion (both 10ms [b]per frame[/b] the bullet hits, duration does not stack)
[/list]
[i][b]Info:[/b] Hitstop adds a very short pauze to the movement of a target, and sometimes also attacker, when getting hit. This increases the impact's feel. The effect is very short, so it should not impact the overall gameplay experience.[/i]

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[*] [b]Added:[/b] Resources preloader. This will reduce lag spikes when certain resources are created
[*] [b]Added:[/b] 3 new background music tracks

[*] [b]Updated:[/b] Accuracy upgrade normal tier to 50%, epic tier to 100%
[*] [b]Updated:[/b] When pressing down direction mid-air you go down faster
[*] [b]Updated:[/b] Amount of weapons spawned for Short Boost reduced to 4~6
[*] [b]Updated:[/b] Players are now not able to change direction during a melee attack
[*] [b]Updated:[/b] Bots navigation when holding Ultra Weapon Singularis
[*] [b]Updated:[/b] Less chance for Pro bots to dash when holding melee weapons
[*] [b]Updated:[/b] Camera shake for all weapons. Also, more camera shake when less players are joined
[*] [b]Updated:[/b] Melee weapon Laser Sword attack soundfx

[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Punch animation not finished causing weapon rotation issues
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Laser Sword beam was visible for a frame when it spawned
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Winner crown, environment and background color did not change in rare occasions
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Mouse visibility for certain scenarios
[hr][/hr]
Please visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3150310/]Community Hub[/url] if you find bugs or have ideas you would like to see implemented.
I'll soon be back with more features. Thank you for playing Miami Fighters!

notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
[h1]EPIC UPDATE[/h1]
I'm back with an epic update! Unlock the first "Divine" 5 star upgrade card to get Auto Aim and crush your opponent with ease. I've also made a sweet Short Boost that drops a bunch of weapons. Come check out the new features and let me know what else you would like to see implemented!

[h2]New upgrade: Auto Aim[/h2]
[*][b]Added:[/b] Auto Aim upgrade. The first "Divine" (5 star) upgrade card

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45165535/7bf934b18f334acb74bd2155710ab915a1a05168.gif[/img]

[*][b]Added:[/b] Hard and Pro bots now dash towards you when holding melee weapons. Pro bots dash more frequently compared to Hard bots

[*][b]Added:[/b] Controller virbration for Lightning and Stun activations
[*][b]Added:[/b] Game pauzes when the game is out of focus

[*][b]Updated:[/b] Passive Healing Amount upgrade to [b]percentage[/b] instead of [b]fixed amount[/b]. Start value is 5%
[*][b]Updated:[/b] All normal bullets trail effect look better now
[*][b]Updated:[/b] Bots navigation to go around solid walls is improved
[*][b]Updated:[/b] Changed Short Boost images to better describing icons
[*][b]Updated:[/b] Changed everything related to the text "Shoot faster" to "Attack faster"
[*][b]Updated:[/b] Getting an Extra Bullet upgrade now has a higher chance. 25% chance when getting Legendary or Mythic
[*][b]Updated:[/b] Camera zooms in less.

[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Demo mode causing duplicate color issues in player selection screen
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Bots kept going right when they were falling outside the map on the right side
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Conveyor platform kept moving back and forth while standing on it
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Ultra Weapon Pulsorion's bullet despawn too soon when round is over. Fixed edges
[hr][/hr]
Please visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3150310/]Community Hub[/url] if you find bugs or have ideas you would like to see implemented.
I'll soon be back with more features. Thank you for playing Miami Fighters!

notes.title: Sneak peek
notes.content:
[h1]REVAMPED UPGRADE SYSTEM[/h1]
I've been working hard to revamp the upgrade system. Various upgrades have been [b]buffed[/b] and the next update will have [b]7 new upgrades[/b]!

[h3]New upgrades[/h3]
7 new upgrades will be available in the next update!
[list][*]Melee weapon block chance
[*]Passive healing chance
[*]Passive healing amount
[*]Invincible while reloading chance
[*]Stun opponent chance
[*]Lightning damage chance
[*]Exploding bullet chance[/list]

[h3]Buffed upgrades[/h3]
Some upgrades have been adjusted to really feel the difference each round you pick them.
[list][*]More accuracy
[*]More knockback
[*]Less recoil[/list]

[h3]Upgrade information[/h3]
You can now see the upgrade's information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45165535/00e78be093189ba789d626c015586af3a71eb213.jpg[/img]

[h1]Stay tuned[/h1]
I'll be putting the changes on the testing branch before the end of this week.
[b]Next week the update will go live![/b]

---

We'll soon be back with more features. Thank you for playing Miami Fighters!

notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
[h1]BIG UPDATE[/h1]
We're back with a big update! Stock Mode is added for MF'ers that prefer to play without time. We also made many new custom accessories and added tons of languages!

[h1]New game mode[/h1]
Stock mode lets you play with lives instead of time. This way you can play more strategic without having to deal with time. Survive the longest to win the round. The amount of stocks is configurable in the Game Options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45165535/0d5ef43f518de804f2a7e0c4863823a64aea21b7.jpg[/img]

[h1]New accessories[/h1]
We added 15 custom made accessories! They are now also pixel perfect, to the character, and animated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45165535/1b6963b7539b27d89cf7658c1a667cfd63cb75a6.jpg[/img]

[h1]New languages[/h1]
The following languages are now present in Miami Fighters
[list]
[*] English
[*] Dutch
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] German
[*] Serbian
[*] Spanish
[*] Japanese
[*] Russian
[*] Portugese[/list]
If you find a translation that is incorrect, please let us know in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3150310/]Community Hub[/url].

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added: Disclaimer seizure warning and updated font size for readability
[*] Added: Apply random accessory for players in demo mode (don't touch any key for 15 seconds in the Main Menu screen to activate demo mode)
[*] Fixed: First press on controller or ESC button didn't do anything in player selection
[*] Fixed: Team mode sub score alignment for 5 and 15 matches
[/list]
Please visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3150310/]Community Hub[/url] if you find bugs or have ideas you would like to see implemented.
We'll soon be back with more features. Thank you for playing Miami Fighters!

[*] Fixed: Starting the match didn't work properly on some devices
[*] Fixed: Custom font not working on non-Windows devices
[*] Fixed: When audio is 0 on Master bus and MF is restarted, the audio does not get set 0
[/list]
Please visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3150310/]Community Hub[/url] if you find bugs or have ideas you would like to see implemented.
We'll soon be back with more features. Thank you for playing Miami Fighters!

notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
We're happy to announce the first update since the release! Full of bug fixes and optimizations. we want everyone to enjoy Miami Fighters, so we added a solid implementation for localization. Adding more languages in the future will now be a lot easier.

[h3]Release notes v0.1.9[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added: Localization (English and Dutch for now, other languages will follow soon)
[*] Optimized: Weapon rotation (faster)
[*] Optimized: Lowered dead zone for aim override
[*] Fixed: Team mode individual player scores not being reset to 0 on round start
[*] Fixed: Closing options using the shortcut not working in pauze mode
[*] Fixed: Main Menu button not working in first second of match
[*] Fixed: If W is pressed, player is unable to jump with Space, and vice versa
[*] Changed: Mouse visibility to only where mouse is needed
[*] Changed: Functionality to start a match
[*] Updated: Many texts and controller layout view
[/list]
Please visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3150310/]Community Hub[/url] if you find bugs or have ideas you would like to see implemented.
We'll soon be back with more features. Thank you for playing Miami Fighters!
